purpose: 中文主视觉海报，定义桥水巷商品系统主题
prompt: Create a polished tourism-merchandise hero poster for Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, Shanghai, in contemporary guochao illustration style that extends an existing public cultural identity without replacing it. Portrait poster, strong hero board, clear hierarchy, generous whitespace, premium retail presentation. Main visual: stylized bridge arch silhouette, curved canal ribbon, oar-stroke stripes, lane perspective blocks, and collector bridge-name labels integrated into one cohesive composition. Show day-to-night narrative transition across the poster, with water-town atmosphere and collectible merchandise sensibility. Include elegant baked-in bilingual text exactly: '水乡慢行系列' as the large Chinese display title, 'Walk the Water Lanes' as supporting headline, and small caption '上海朱家角古镇  ·  Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, Shanghai'. Palette must use only these colors: river-jade #4F7C74, lantern-gold #D8A14A, wall-paper #F2EBDD, with optional stone-ink #2F3A3D linework. Typography roles visible: display, headline, caption. Avoid direct photo tracing, avoid post office retro language, avoid stamps, postmarks, imperial postal insignia, no generic Jiangnan watercolor cliche, no fake Latin text.
